final: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) AS ast_minus_alt, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(ast_minus_alt) AS avg_of_status_ast_minus_alt, AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_of_status_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status
